text: 7月15日，外交部发言人林剑主持例行记者会。据报道，美国14日公布了对俄罗斯制裁法案的更新版本，新版措施把包括中国和印度在内的俄罗斯原油和天然气五大买家列为制裁目标，授权特朗普对相关国家最高征收100%的关税。彭博社记者在会上就此事提问，中方对此有何回应？ 林剑强调，中方坚决反对没有国际法依据、未经联合国安理会授权的非法单边制裁，将采取一切必要措施，坚定维护本国企业和公民的正当权益。“搞双重标准，胁迫施压，最终只会搬起石头砸自己的脚。”林剑说。（澎湃新闻）
text_en: On July 15, Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian hosted a regular press conference. Reports said the US released an updated version of its Russia sanctions law on the 14th, with new measures targeting Russia's top five buyers of crude oil and natural gas including China and India, authorizing Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100% on relevant countries. A Bloomberg reporter asked for China's response. Lin Jian stressed China firmly opposes illegal unilateral sanctions without UN Security Council authorization, and will take all necessary measures to firmly protect the legitimate rights and interests of its firms and citizens. 'Double standards, coercion and pressure will only end up backfiring,' Lin Jian said. (The Paper)
